The '''Skorrupon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Skorrupon/Legends|Skorrupon]].

==History==
[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces attempted to [[Battle of Skorrupon (Galactic Civil War)|ambush]] the newly christened [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]], [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], in the space above Skorrupon, shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Skorrupon system was [[Battle of the Skorrupon system|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEA" />
